cover-modes.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a long light oak desk in a calm studio, clearly divided into three working zones from left to right: an open notebook with illegible handwriting and a cup of tea; neat stacks of kraft paper folders and loose documents being sorted; a laptop beside a small handmade cardboard model of a shopfront. A Kazakh woman entrepreneur in her thirties stands behind the middle zone, one hand resting on the folders, glancing toward the model with a confident half-smile. She wears a muted deep violet linen shirt; real skin texture, natural relaxed hands. The laptop screen is angled away. Lighting: soft natural window light from the left, warm peach accents, cool lavender shadows. Composition 4:5 vertical, the woman and three zones in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, dark, uniform front edge of the desk in shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos, no readable screens.
